featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Khire
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely unprofessional behavior. They don’t pick up calls during normal business hours and claim they are out of town and only available via text, yet reply on Sunday saying it’s their holiday. They quoted Rs. 12L for a 3-day event including photography and a wedding film, but when I asked what the videography actually includes (short reel, documentary, trailer, etc.), the only response was, “Yes, videography is included.” That level of communication is unacceptable for a service at this price point.

When I raised concerns, they asked for my email to send details even though a PDF could easily be shared on WhatsApp. Only after I said I cannot manage such important discussions over text did they agree to a phone call, and even then the tone felt like they were doing me a favor while on holiday. If you’re on holiday, don’t respond. I’ve dealt with far more reputed and well-known vendors who communicate far more professionally.

featured_reviews.name: Aman Choudhary
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Photo Lab team are an absolute delight to work with. My wife contacted them to cover our wedding after receiving glowing reviews and they exceeded our expectations.

Harsh and team were very friendly, patient, meticulous and efficient in their work. The attention to detail as well as excellent composition for our wedding videos/photos just left us speechless.  We are very happy that we worked with them to capture such golden memories and can't recommend them enough.

Keep up the fabulous work!

featured_reviews.name: Manali Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: I booked them for my 3-day wedding after a friend recommended. And trust me you guys, they were the best! They didn’t miss a single moment and caught every little memory for us making our wedding beautiful with their photos. They were completely candid and didn’t ask to pose like those typical photographers. If you’re looking for something super natural and cute book them! They’re very good feasible  as well. Their team is very sweet and won’t disturb you throughout the wedding. They really made our day super nice with their edited photos and videos. They’re got the best team! I’ve booked them again for my sisters wedding! Book them you guys! They’re amazing!

featured_reviews.name: Jovita D'Silva
featured_reviews.review_text: We have only amazing things to say about the entire Photo Lab team. They have been nothing but absolutely professional. I loved that they were attentive to our requests and were even able to accommodate for them. They even helped calm down our pre wedding jitters. I truly believe that the images and videos from your wedding day are the only thing that will last you forever. And for that very reason you should never ever compromise on hiring the best. For us the best was an obvious choice!

featured_reviews.name: dimple sutaria
featured_reviews.review_text: We had an amazing experience with The Photo Lab. They shot our engagement earlier in February this year. Harsh and the team were super enthusiastic as well as understanding and co-operative in terms of what we wanted for our special day. Very responsive. Overall they made sure we looked like a dream and did not let us down. Would definitely recommend them <3

featured_reviews.name: Sanjay Chhabria
featured_reviews.review_text:
A big kudos to Harsh and his team to have covered our wedding beautifully. When we first saw our pictures and the video we were in love with it and had no words on how elegantly and naturally they have covered each and every moment of the wedding. Super fast deliverables and they are very professional and clear in their work and understanding. Loved their editing!!

Would really love to thank The Photo Lab team to have done such a wonderful work in capturing our special day!!

featured_reviews.name: Shreya Chopra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great photography was one of the top priorities for our wedding & The Photo Lab delivered spectacular memories.
From understanding our vibe to working on the minutest detail, they made sure to get some of the best shots. We loved working with them & they did a great job to capture every moment of our wedding so beautifully! They are easy to work with & extremely professional & I would highly recommend them.

featured_reviews.name: Arnab Bhattacharya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Harsh and his team of photographers and videographers at The Photo Lab are extremely talented individuals. Their candid shots are true, unadulterated memories of our wedding and I thank them profusely for capturing the best moments during the event.

The video, underlined by apt music,  brings out the excitement and happiness of our families throughout the wedding. I have only received great compliments from everyone who has seen their content.

We are grateful to The Photo Lab for accommodating all our requests and delivering content that will be cherished for a lifetime.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Choosing our wedding photographer was one of the best decisions we made (right after choosing each other 😄). The Shiva Photography somehow managed to capture all the love, laughter, happy tears, and even the moments when we had no idea where to look or what to do with our hands!

The photos are beautiful, natural, and full of memories we will cherish forever. Looking through them feels like reliving the whole day all over again. Thank you Harshal for being so easy to work with and for giving us photos we will probably force all our friends and family to look at for years to come!

More and more love to you ❤️❤️❤️❤️
You have been the best!!

featured_reviews.name: Riddhi Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text: We had an amazing experience with Harshal and team (Ashish & Jeetu) from The Shiva Photography capturing our most special Baby Shower occasion! We connected through Instagram and were very anxious initially but from the beginning till the end of the event they kept the conversation and experience very smooth and trustworthy. Their friendly nature, patience, and professionalism truly stood out. Throughout the event they made us feel completely comfortable and at ease. They captured every special moment beautifully and naturally, giving us memories we’ll cherish forever. The photos turned out absolutely stunning, and we couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Highly recommended for anyone looking to capture their special occasions perfectly!

featured_reviews.name: Sweta Panchamia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Harshal and his team are my go to photographers after the first time I hired them for my engagement ceremony. They have captured anything and everything that I demanded and so beautifully!
They have made sure to accommodate all my choices and likings and always made everyone - my family, guests, and myself comfortable while they’re capturing our memories.

They’ve also done my father’s office opening, my lagan lekhan, and mehendi!

I would for sure recommend The Shiva Photography to everyone who wants someone to capture their most memorable moments of their life and bring a smile to their face!
